summary: Manticore is the Scorched Earth guardian. Establish desert supplies before moving from artifact caves to the arena.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.

steps.title: 1 · Desert supplies
steps.reason: Secure water, heat protection and spare equipment so cave trips do not consume the army budget.

steps.title: 2 · Artifacts and army
steps.reason: Collect the difficulty-specific tribute set. Prepare ranged damage for the flying phases.

steps.title: 3 · Manticore: Gamma → Beta → Alpha
steps.reason: Raise difficulty after a clean win with health and time to spare; keep the same save settings for meaningful comparisons.

loadouts.entry: Check current ASA tribute and creature eligibility at the terminal before committing your team.
loadouts.warning: The Stego + Velonasaur example needs transfers or a compatible cluster. The native-team options below are planning suggestions, not independently measured Alpha wins.

options.title: Stego + Velonasaur · ASA solo Alpha example
options.team: Stegosaurus provides a protected riding position; Velonasaur supplies ranged damage.
options.why: The creator explicitly describes this combination in a full ASA solo Alpha guide. No minimum stats are inferred from its description.
options.play: Review setup at 00:20, flight cycles, positioning and safe damage windows. Avoid chasing the boss through the arena.
options.confidence: ASA creator metadata confirms the setup; stats and saddles have not been independently measured.

options.title: Native Rex army + Yutyrannus
options.team: Build a bred, imprinted Rex line with a ridden Yutyrannus if eligible.
options.why: A conventional land team provides a practical local breeding project; this is a suggested Gamma starting plan.
options.play: Keep the herd together, maintain courage and use landing windows; bring a ranged backup rather than relying on frequent landings.
options.confidence: Planning suggestion based on arena mechanics; no verified minimum stats or guaranteed win.

options.title: Native Wyvern team
options.team: Prepare a controlled Wyvern group; check flyer eligibility at the ASA terminal.
options.why: A flyer plan can follow aerial phases, but a different composition changes positioning and landing behavior.
options.play: Rehearse movement and attack control before entry; keep team composition consistent when judging the flight cycle.
options.confidence: Planning suggestion based on arena mechanics; no verified minimum stats or guaranteed win.
